title: Typologiekonstruktie 1978 : Vaardigheidscursus data-analyse
authors: Weegh, P.H.M. op de, Kerssemakers, F.A.M., Hutjes, J.M., Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (primary investigator)
contributors: Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (data collector)
descriptions: A course on data analysis, in particular typology construction. For secondary analysis are used the data of a survey named contents of the sales function in retail trade in which sales functions are units of observation.
